# ADR-3253: AWS security_groups: Prefer prefix lists for shared CIDR sets 5

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Copied CIDR lists drift.

## Decision

Network teams SHOULD prefer prefix lists for shared CIDR sets 5 (AWS-security_groups-5) when many SGs share sources.

## Consequences

Managed prefix lists are the source of truth.
